documentation.description: Returns up to `size` distinct terms of one field that start with `string`, merged across shards in UTF-8 byte order. A response with `complete: false` may miss terms anywhere in its range; do not page with `search_after` from it. When `index_filter` skips every shard, the field is not validated and the response has no terms.

index.description: A comma-separated list of index names, aliases or data streams to enumerate terms from

ignore_unavailable.description: Whether specified concrete indices should be ignored when unavailable (missing or closed)

allow_no_indices.description: Whether to ignore if a wildcard indices expression resolves into no concrete indices. (This includes `_all` string or when no indices have been specified)

expand_wildcards.description: Whether to expand wildcard expression to concrete indices that are open, closed or both.

body.description: field (required), string, size, case_insensitive, timeout, index_filter, search_after
